name: The life of Jesus in 21 days
description: Walk with Jesus from His birth to His resurrection through key moments in the four Gospels, one short reading a day.

days.title: The promise to Mary
days.note: An angel brings astonishing news to a young woman in a small town. Watch how Mary responds.
questions: What does Mary's answer in verse 38 teach you about trust?

days.title: Born in Bethlehem
days.note: The Saviour arrives quietly, and the first to hear are shepherds working the night shift.
questions: Why do you think God announced Jesus' birth to shepherds first?

days.title: The boy in the temple
days.note: The only story of Jesus as a boy shows Him already aware of who His Father is.
questions: What does verse 52 suggest about how Jesus grew?

days.title: Baptism and testing
days.note: Before His ministry begins, Jesus hears His Father's delight and then faces temptation in the wilderness.
questions: How does Jesus answer each temptation, and what can you learn from it?

days.title: The first followers
days.note: The first followers meet Jesus, and each one brings someone else along.
questions: Who first told you about Jesus? Who could you invite to meet Him?

days.title: Water into wine
days.note: Jesus' first sign happens at a wedding, saving a family from embarrassment.
questions: What does this miracle show you about what Jesus cares about?

days.title: Jesus' mission
days.note: In His hometown synagogue, Jesus reads from Isaiah and says it is fulfilled today.
questions: Why did the crowd's mood change so quickly?

days.title: The blessed
days.note: Jesus begins His great sermon by calling unexpected people blessed.
questions: Which of these blessings surprises you most, and why?

days.title: Forgiven and healed
days.note: Friends dig through a roof to bring a paralysed man to Jesus.
questions: Why do you think Jesus spoke of forgiveness before healing?

days.title: Extravagant love
days.note: At a dinner party, a woman with a reputation shows extravagant love for Jesus.
questions: How does the parable in verses 41-43 explain her love?

days.title: Calming the storm
days.note: A storm terrifies experienced fishermen, while Jesus sleeps.
questions: What storm are you facing? What is Jesus' question to you in verse 40?

days.title: Bread for thousands
days.note: Jesus sees a crowd like sheep without a shepherd and feeds them from a little.
questions: What 'little' could you offer Jesus to use?

days.title: Who is Jesus?
days.note: Peter names Jesus as the Christ, then struggles with what that will mean.
questions: How would you answer Jesus' question in verse 15?

days.title: On the mountain
days.note: Three disciples glimpse Jesus' glory and hear the Father speak.
questions: What would it mean for you to listen to Jesus this week?

days.title: Lazarus
days.note: Jesus weeps with grieving friends before calling Lazarus out of the tomb.
questions: What does it mean to you that Jesus wept?

days.title: Zacchaeus
days.note: A disliked tax collector climbs a tree to see Jesus, and Jesus invites Himself to dinner.
questions: How did meeting Jesus change Zacchaeus?

days.title: The King arrives
days.note: Jesus rides into Jerusalem on a donkey and clears the temple.
questions: What kind of king does Jesus show Himself to be here?

days.title: Washing feet
days.note: On His last night, Jesus takes the role of a servant.
questions: Whose 'feet' could you serve this week?

days.title: In the garden
days.note: Jesus prays in anguish, is arrested, and Peter denies knowing Him.
questions: What do you notice about how Jesus prays in verse 42?

days.title: The cross
days.note: Jesus is crucified, caring for His mother even from the cross.
questions: What do Jesus' last words in verse 30 mean to you?

days.title: On the Emmaus road
days.note: The risen Jesus walks with two grieving friends, and they recognise Him at the table.
questions: Where have you sensed Jesus walking with you during these 21 days?
